conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta names. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while incorporating a high-scoring new setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet the concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay/rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is paramount to manage the increased risk.
